cause_claim: The change GRANT SELECT ON r0.* to svc_bundle_reader doubled the rows visible to bundle-builder from 99 (baseline/control) to 198 (candidate). The worker-runtime max_entries limit is 200 (runtime_config:rc-0004). The candidate value of 198 is within the limit but dangerously close — any additional data access or slight increase could exceed 200, causing the worker to fail or truncate bundles.
